{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravity bomb launchers''' were projectile weapons used by the [[Yevetha]] on their [[Aramadia-class thrustship|''Aramadia''-class thrustship]]. Each [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was armed with six gravity bomb launchers, each holding a magazine of four [[gravity bomb]]s per load.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
